pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo bhikkhuniyā ummaddāpentipi parimaddāpentipi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.3: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo bhikkhuniyā ummaddāpessantipi parimaddāpessantipi seyyathāpi gihīkāmabhoginiyo”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.7: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo bhikkhuniyā ummaddāpessantipi parimaddāpessanti pī”ti. …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo bhikkhuniyā ummaddāpenti pi parimaddāpenti pīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo bhikkhuniyā ummaddāpessanti pi parimaddāpessanti pi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.14.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī bhikkhuniyā ummaddāpeyya vā parimaddāpeyya vā pācittiya”nti.
